local_context.value: Town centre on a low ridge at 62 ft (page; infobox says 16 ft, so inconsistent) — name refers to some of the highest land in Jasper County. 2020 census population about 3,750; 1,151 housing units, 9.6% vacant; median age 36.4. Page has no climate/hurricane/flood text.

neighborhoods.value: Partial (target 6): Bee's Creek / The Groves at Bees Creek — new-home subdivision off Bees Creek Road, in Town of Ridgeland records (Planning Commission 2022-08-08 agenda: Lennar 'Bee's Creek Phase II' preliminary plat; 2026-09-14 packet map 'Groves at Bees Creek (T3)'); build-out status unclear — name it only as a new-home community off Bees Creek Road. The downtown residential core is an area, not a subdivision (Paul's research). 'Bees Creek Plantation' has only real-estate listings — not citable. A Ridgeland postal address does not prove the home is inside town limits: use 'Ridgeland and nearby residential communities'.
neighborhoods.source: https://www.ridgelandsc.gov/pdfs/Planning-Commission-August-8th-2022-Agenda.pdf ; https://www.ridgelandsc.gov/pdfs/Planning-Commission-September-14-2026-Agenda-Packet.pdf (read 2026-10-12; research log RL-locations-9, run 20261012-205526-build-9baf); Paul's research 2026-10-12 (answers-round-2.md)

things_to_do.value: Ridgeland farmers market (weekends, April to December); visit the historic sites Old House Plantation and Old Baptist Church.

top_sites.value: Jasper County Courthouse (Ridgeland is the county seat); Old House Plantation (childhood home of Thomas Heyward Jr., Declaration of Independence signer); Old Baptist Church (former Union forces headquarters).
